note: The session's shared web-search allowance was used up after four searches for this part, so the rest was read from official pages reached directly (the Legislative Research Commission, Kentucky Courts' county pages, county and city sites); many county sites did not resolve, and Radcliff's site refused the connection. Most of the 30 candidates (magistrates, constables, coroners, jailer, sheriffs, county judge/executives, school boards) were not found on any page that could be read and are left blank. Not the same person or not in office, so nothing recorded: Woodford County's County Attorney page names Alan J. George, not Carmine G. Iaccarino; Hopkinsville's Ward 1 page names Vance Smith, not Chance Andrew Tatum; Danville's Meet the Commission list does not include Jonah Cline. Party pages that list Gooch, Looney, Gary Ginn and John Bays without saying endorsed are already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json and are not repeated here. Keisha Dorsey's age (33 at her swearing-in) does not settle one birth year, so none is recorded. Jim Gooch Jr. sits in the Legislature with a record page; only his official page and his earlier runs under the Democratic label are recorded. Verifier (2026-10-03): every url re-opened and every finding confirmed; Gooch's past-party wording and the source of Dorsey's council years corrected to what the pages say.
